concerns.text: The plan validates Δ Score enrichment in GWAS loci using a Kolmogorov‑Smirnov (KS) test on the full Δ Score distribution (see Summary line ‘tests whether Δ Score distributions are enriched in GWAS Catalog lead SNPs via a KS test’). KS assumes independent, identically‑distributed samples, but SNPs are correlated within LD blocks. Although the permutation scheme shuffles GWAS labels within LD blocks, the observed KS statistic is still computed on correlated data, violating the test’s independence assumption and potentially inflating Type I error.
